messages:
lina_sales: Passing Sycamore (sycamore.ai) to CS — pilot starts 2025-04-12. Deal signed (12mo). Pilot metrics decide expansion. Needs: Okta SAML + SCIM, VPC peering for logs, possible private deployment later. Legal requested SOC2 evidence; could delay go-live if unresolved. Please own onboarding, open infra ticket, and confirm owners. Main contacts: Tessa (IT, tessa@sycamore.ai) and finance@sycamore.ai. Raj is primary SE.

raj_se: Tech notes: Okta with SCIM provisioning. No PII in payloads, only activity metadata. Expected peak ~50 concurrent requests, avg seq ~600 tokens. Plan: open-13b quantized. Uploaded Okta metadata to S3 (link in email). Example SCIM test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.sycamore.ai/scim/v2/Users
```

emma_cs: I'll take onboarding lead — assigning @emma_cs. Scheduling kickoff next Tue. Can someone confirm billing contact (we have finance@sycamore.ai) and paste the Okta SAML metadata here?

lina_sales: Billing: finance@sycamore.ai. Okta metadata copied to email + uploaded to S3: https://s3.company/sycamore/okta_metadata.xml :point_down:

emma_cs: :thumbsup: Creating CS ticket and infra request. Tentative owners: emma_cs (onboarding), theo_support (support triage), kyle_infra (private/dedicated feasibility).

theo_support: Opening support ticket and tagging priority 'pilot-go-live'. Any retention/encryption requirements?

raj_se: They requested 90-day activity log retention and KMS-based encryption (AWS). If private deployment pursued, HSM/KMS integration required.

kyle_infra: I'll scope Dedicated sizing. Rough calc: 50 concurrent qps with 13b quantized suggests starting with 2 medium GPU nodes for canary; will validate after sample prompt distribution (p95 seq length).

emma_cs: Next steps (owners): 1) Schedule kickoff with Sycamore + Raj + Emma (by Fri) — Owner: emma_cs; 2) CS to pull Okta SAML metadata + confirm billing contact — Owner: emma_cs; 3) Support: open infra ticket + set SLA expectations — Owner: theo_support (SUP-8721); 4) Infra: initial sizing + private deploy feasibility — Owner: kyle_infra; 5) Enablement: send trial owners a short playbook and monitoring checklist — Owner: emma_cs. I'll update post-kickoff.

lina_sales: Renewal watch window = 3 months before contract end. Flag renewal risk if legal drags >6 weeks. Expansion likely if pilot metrics are good.

theo_support: Created ticket SUP-8721. CC'd @kyle_infra and @emma_cs. Labels: okta, kms, pilot-go-live.

emma_cs: Quick ask to infra/eng — can you provide a short CSV of sample conversation size distribution (percentiles) so I can set token caps in trial UI?

kyle_infra: Will share latency/throughput assumptions and sample prompt-size distribution doc by EOD. Looping in @sophie_reliability for SLO recommendations.

sophie_reliability: For pilot SLOs recommend p95 inference latency <300ms and p99 <800ms. Fallback policy: route to hosted model variant if Dedicated is degraded. I'll draft the policy.

emma_cs: Also need an owner for post-kickoff feedback capture / NPS mid-pilot.

lina_sales: Looping in @jordan_customer to own feedback/NPS follow-up.

jordan_customer: Happy to own feedback and NPS. I'll prepare 3 focused prompts for quality checks and a short 4-question survey for pilot midpoint.

emma_cs: Great — I'll post kickoff invite, CS ticket links, and infra Jira links here once created. :sparkles:
file_note: handoff thread for Sycamore pilot; sales-to-cs + cs-to-support/infra coordination
